description: Leelaratne Dassanayake v. Nicholas Marcus Fernando, Archbishop of Colombo and Another Leelaratne Dassanayake v. Nicholas Marcus Fernando, Archbishop of Colombo and Another View More before A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: Leelaratne Dassanayake v. Nicholas Marcus Fernando, Archbishop of Colombo and Another Leelaratne Dassanayake v. Nicholas Marcus Fernando, Archbishop of Colombo and Another View More
keywords: Plaintiff\'s action for declaration of title dismissed by District Court for lack of proof. Defendants\' counter-claim also dismissed. Held - reversed the dismissal of the counter-claim, finding the Archbishop of Colombo held a clear, unbroken chain of title dating to 1888. Appeal allowed; 1st Defendant declared lawful owner. No costs awarded.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
